```javascript
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  "use strict";
  window.globalSavedRequirements = window.globalSavedRequirements || [];

  const compiledAmendments = document.getElementById("compiledAmendments");

  const compiledRequirements = document.getElementById("compiledRequirements");

  const amendmentCount = document.getElementById("compiledAmendmentCount");

  const requirementCount = document.getElementById("compiledRequirementCount");

  const totalCount = document.getElementById("compiledTotalCount");

  const amendmentBadge = document.getElementById("compiledAmendmentBadge");

  const requirementBadge = document.getElementById("compiledRequirementBadge");

  const outputStatus = document.getElementById("reviewOutputStatus");

  const copyAllAmendmentsButton = document.getElementById("copyAllAmendments");

  const copyAllRequirementsButton = document.getElementById(
    "copyAllRequirements",
  );

  const copyStatus = document.getElementById("reviewOutputCopyStatus");

  let compileTimer = null;

  function cleanText(value) {
    return String(value || "")
      .replace(/\r\n/g, "\n")
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
      .trim();
  }

  function getFormRows() {
    return Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll('.required-form-row[data-form-status="nigo"]'),
    );
  }

  function getFormInformation(row) {
    const formId =
      row.dataset.formId ||
      row.querySelector(".state-form-id")?.textContent?.trim() ||
      "NIGO Form";

    const description =
      row.querySelector(".form-description")?.textContent?.trim() || "";

    return {
      formId,
      description,
    };
  }

  function collectGeneratedAmendments() {
    const results = [];

    getFormRows().forEach(function (row) {
      const form = getFormInformation(row);

      const panel = row.querySelector(".form-nigo-panel");

      const amendments = JSON.parse(panel?.dataset.amendments || "[]");

      amendments.forEach(function (amendment) {
        results.push({
          formId: form.formId,

          description: form.description,

          text: amendment.wording,
        });
      });
    });

    return results;
  }

  function collectGeneratedRequirements() {
    const requirements = Array.isArray(window.globalSavedRequirements)
      ? window.globalSavedRequirements
      : [];

    return requirements
      .map(function (requirement) {
        if (typeof requirement === "string") {
          return {
            formId: "",
            description: "",
            text: requirement.trim(),
          };
        }

        return {
          formId: requirement.formId || "",

          description: requirement.description || "",

          text: String(requirement.text || "").trim(),
        };
      })
      .filter(function (requirement) {
        return Boolean(requirement.text);
      });
  }

  function formatCompiledItems(items) {
    if (items.length === 0) {
      return "";
    }

    return items
      .map(function (item) {
        return item.text;
      })
      .join("\n");
  }

  function updateOutputReadiness() {
    document
      .querySelectorAll('.required-form-row[data-form-status="nigo"]')
      .forEach(function (row) {
        const amendment = cleanText(
          row.querySelector(".generated-amendment")?.value,
        );

        const requirement = cleanText(
          row.querySelector(".generated-requirement")?.value,
        );

        row.classList.toggle("amendment-output-ready", Boolean(amendment));

        row.classList.toggle("requirement-output-ready", Boolean(requirement));
      });
  }

  function compileReviewOutputs() {
    const amendments = collectGeneratedAmendments();

    const requirements = collectGeneratedRequirements();

    const amendmentText = formatCompiledItems(amendments);

    const requirementText = formatCompiledItems(requirements);

    if (compiledAmendments) {
      compiledAmendments.value = amendmentText;
    }

    if (compiledRequirements) {
      compiledRequirements.value = requirementText;
    }
    document.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("compiledRequirementsUpdated", {
        detail: {
          requirements: compiledRequirements.value,
        },
      }),
    );
    if (amendmentCount) {
      amendmentCount.textContent = String(amendments.length);
    }

    if (requirementCount) {
      requirementCount.textContent = String(requirements.length);
    }

    if (totalCount) {
      totalCount.textContent = String(amendments.length + requirements.length);
    }

    if (amendmentBadge) {
      amendmentBadge.textContent =
        amendments.length + " amendment" + (amendments.length === 1 ? "" : "s");
    }

    if (requirementBadge) {
      requirementBadge.textContent =
        requirements.length +
        " requirement" +
        (requirements.length === 1 ? "" : "s");
    }

    if (copyAllAmendmentsButton) {
      copyAllAmendmentsButton.disabled = amendments.length === 0;
    }

    if (copyAllRequirementsButton) {
      copyAllRequirementsButton.disabled = requirements.length === 0;
    }

    if (outputStatus) {
      const totalOutputs = amendments.length + requirements.length;

      outputStatus.textContent =
        totalOutputs > 0
          ? totalOutputs +
            " Output" +
            (totalOutputs === 1 ? "" : "s") +
            " Ready"
          : "No Outputs";

      outputStatus.classList.toggle("complete", totalOutputs > 0);
    }

    updateOutputReadiness();
  }

  function scheduleCompile() {
    window.clearTimeout(compileTimer);

    /*
     * Wait until amendment-engine.js finishes
     * updating its generated textarea values.
     */
    compileTimer = window.setTimeout(compileReviewOutputs, 0);
  }

  async function copyText(textarea, successMessage) {
    if (!textarea || !textarea.value.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(textarea.value);
    } catch (error) {
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.select();

      document.execCommand("copy");
    }

    if (copyStatus) {
      copyStatus.textContent = successMessage;

      window.setTimeout(function () {
        copyStatus.textContent = "";
      }, 1800);
    }
  }

  if (copyAllAmendmentsButton) {
    copyAllAmendmentsButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
      copyText(compiledAmendments, "All policy amendments copied.");
    });
  }

  if (copyAllRequirementsButton) {
    copyAllRequirementsButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
      copyText(compiledRequirements, "All agency requirements copied.");
    });
  }

  /*
   * User changes that may create or update
   * an amendment or requirement.
   */
  document.addEventListener("input", scheduleCompile);

  document.addEventListener("change", scheduleCompile);

  document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
    if (
      event.target.closest("[data-form-action]") ||
      event.target.closest(".amendment-template") ||
      event.target.closest(".requirement-template")
    ) {
      scheduleCompile();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("stateFormsUpdated", scheduleCompile);

  document.addEventListener("nigoPanelOpened", scheduleCompile);

  document.addEventListener("requirementsUpdated", scheduleCompile);
  /*
   * Watch for stateLoader.js rebuilding
   * the required-form rows.
   */
  const requiredFormsContainer = document.getElementById("requiredForms");

  if (requiredFormsContainer) {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(scheduleCompile);

    observer.observe(requiredFormsContainer, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true,
    });
  }

  compileReviewOutputs();
});
function getIllustrationValidationOutput() {
  const validation = window.fullIRIllustrationValidation;

  if (!validation || !validation.completed) {
    return "";
  }

  const summary = validation.summary;

  const lines = [
    "ILLUSTRATION VALIDATION",
    `Matches: ${summary.matches}`,
    `Mismatches: ${summary.mismatches}`,
    `Manual review: ${summary.reviews}`,
  ];

  validation.actionableItems.forEach((item) => {
    lines.push(
      `${item.label}: ` +
        `${item.application} / ` +
        `${item.illustration} - ` +
        `${item.status}`,
    );
  });

  return lines.join("\n");
}
```

```javascript
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const beginButton = document.getElementById("beginReviewButton");
  const questionOne = document.getElementById("questionProduct");

  if (beginButton && questionOne) {
    beginButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
      window.scrollTo({
        top: questionOne.offsetTop - 100,
        behavior: "smooth",
      });
    });
  }

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
    function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add("in-view");
        }
      });
    },
    {
      threshold: 0.25,
    },
  );

  document.querySelectorAll(".question-panel").forEach(function (panel) {
    observer.observe(panel);
  });
});
```

```javascript
(() => {
  "use strict";

  window.formReviewStatus = window.formReviewStatus || {};
  window.activeNigoRow = null;

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * GENERAL HELPERS
   * =========================================================
   */

  function escapeHTML(value) {
    return String(value ?? "")
      .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
      .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
      .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
      .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
      .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");
  }

  function normalizeFormValues(value) {
    if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
      return [];
    }

    return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
  }

  function getRequirementBuilder() {
    return $("nigoRequirementBuilder");
  }

  function getRequirementBuilderParking() {
    return $("requirementBuilderParking");
  }

  function getActiveNigoInformation() {
    const row = window.activeNigoRow;

    if (!row || !document.body.contains(row)) {
      return null;
    }

    const formId = row.dataset.formId || "";
    const formDescription = row.dataset.formDescription || formId;

    return {
      row,
      formId,
      formDescription,
    };
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * STATE NOTICE RENDERING
   * =========================================================
   */

  function renderNotices(stateData) {
    const container = $("stateImportantNotices");

    if (!container) {
      return;
    }

    const notices = Array.isArray(stateData.important)
      ? stateData.important
      : [];

    if (!notices.length) {
      container.innerHTML = "";
      container.hidden = true;
      return;
    }

    container.hidden = false;

    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="state-notice state-notice-important">
        <h3>Important</h3>

        <ul>
          ${notices
            .map((notice) => {
              return `<li>${escapeHTML(notice)}</li>`;
            })
            .join("")}
        </ul>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderNotes(stateData) {
    const container = $("stateNotes");

    if (!container) {
      return;
    }

    const notes = Array.isArray(stateData.notes) ? stateData.notes : [];

    if (!notes.length) {
      container.innerHTML = "";
      container.hidden = true;
      return;
    }

    container.hidden = false;

    container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="state-notice">
        <h3>State Notes</h3>

        <ul>
          ${notes
            .map((note) => {
              return `<li>${escapeHTML(note)}</li>`;
            })
            .join("")}
        </ul>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * CONDITIONAL FORM EVALUATION
   * =========================================================
   */

  function evaluateConditions(conditions) {
    if (!Array.isArray(conditions) || conditions.length === 0) {
      return true;
    }

    return conditions.every((condition) => {
      const field = condition.field;
      const value = condition.value;
      const operator = condition.operator;

      let current;

      switch (field) {
        case "replacement":
          current = $("replacement")?.checked ? "yes" : "no";
          break;

        case "additionalInsured":
          current = $("additionalInsured")?.checked ? "yes" : "no";
          break;

        case "beneficiaryOther":
          current = $("beneficiaryOther")?.value || "";
          break;

        case "ownerType":
          current = $("ownerType")?.value || "";
          break;

        default:
          /*
           * This standalone page may not contain every Initial
           * Review condition field. An unknown condition should
           * not display the conditional form.
           */
          return false;
      }

      if (operator === "equals") {
        return current === value;
      }

      if (operator === "notEquals") {
        return current !== value;
      }

      if (operator === "includes") {
        return normalizeFormValues(value).includes(current);
      }

      return false;
    });
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * REQUIREMENT GENERATOR STATE
   * =========================================================
   */

  function getRequirementFieldValues() {
    const values = {};

    document
      .querySelectorAll("#globalRequirementFields [data-requirement-field]")
      .forEach((field) => {
        values[field.dataset.requirementField] = field.value || "";
      });

    return values;
  }

  function clearGlobalRequirementDraft() {
    const dropdown = $("globalRequirementTemplate");
    const fields = $("globalRequirementFields");
    const output = $("globalGeneratedRequirement");
    const status = $("requirementSaveStatus");

    if (dropdown) {
      dropdown.value = "";

      dropdown.dispatchEvent(
        new Event("change", {
          bubbles: true,
        }),
      );
    }

    if (fields) {
      fields.innerHTML = "";
    }

    if (output) {
      output.value = "";
      output.placeholder = "Select a requirement template.";
    }

    if (status) {
      status.textContent = "";
    }
  }

  function populateActiveRequirementFormField() {
    const active = getActiveNigoInformation();

    if (!active) {
      return;
    }

    const fields = $("globalRequirementFields");

    if (!fields) {
      return;
    }

    const formField = fields.querySelector(
      '[data-requirement-field="formName"],' +
        '[data-requirement-field="documentName"],' +
        '[data-requirement-field="supplementName"],' +
        '[data-requirement-field="item"]',
    );

    if (!formField || formField.value.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    formField.value = active.formDescription;

    formField.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("input", {
        bubbles: true,
      }),
    );

    formField.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("change", {
        bubbles: true,
      }),
    );
  }

  function syncActiveNigoRequirement() {
    const active = getActiveNigoInformation();

    if (!active) {
      return;
    }

    const dropdown = $("globalRequirementTemplate");
    const output = $("globalGeneratedRequirement");

    const templateId = dropdown?.value || "";

    const selectedOption = dropdown?.options[dropdown.selectedIndex];

    const issueLabel = selectedOption?.textContent?.trim() || "";

    const requirementText = output?.value?.trim() || "";

    const resultText = active.row.querySelector(".form-review-result");

    window.formReviewStatus[active.formId] = {
      status: templateId ? "NIGO" : "NIGO_PENDING",
      issueLabel,
      templateId,
      formId: active.formId,
      formDescription: active.formDescription,
      requirementGenerated: Boolean(requirementText),
      requirementText,
      fieldValues: getRequirementFieldValues(),
    };

    active.row.dataset.formStatus = templateId ? "nigo" : "nigo-pending";

    if (resultText) {
      if (templateId) {
        resultText.textContent = `NIGO: ${issueLabel}`;
        resultText.className = "form-review-result result-nigo";
        resultText.title = issueLabel;
      } else {
        resultText.textContent = "Select Requirement";
        resultText.className = "form-review-result result-nigo-pending";
        resultText.title = "";
      }
    }

    updateStateDashboard();
    checkReviewCompletion();

    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("stateFormsUpdated"));
  }

  function refreshActiveNigoRequirement() {
    /*
     * amendment-engine.js handles the change first and creates
     * the dynamic fields. The timeout lets that finish.
     */
    window.setTimeout(() => {
      populateActiveRequirementFormField();

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        syncActiveNigoRequirement();
      }, 0);
    }, 0);
  }

  function restoreRequirementDraft(formId) {
    const saved = window.formReviewStatus[formId];

    if (!saved?.templateId) {
      clearGlobalRequirementDraft();
      return;
    }

    const dropdown = $("globalRequirementTemplate");

    if (!dropdown) {
      return;
    }

    dropdown.value = saved.templateId;

    dropdown.dispatchEvent(
      new Event("change", {
        bubbles: true,
      }),
    );

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      const savedValues = saved.fieldValues || {};

      document
        .querySelectorAll("#globalRequirementFields [data-requirement-field]")
        .forEach((field) => {
          const fieldName = field.dataset.requirementField;

          if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(savedValues, fieldName)) {
            field.value = savedValues[fieldName];

            field.dispatchEvent(
              new Event("input", {
                bubbles: true,
              }),
            );
          }
        });

      populateActiveRequirementFormField();

      window.setTimeout(() => {
        syncActiveNigoRequirement();
      }, 0);
    }, 0);
  }

  function parkRequirementBuilder({ clearDraft = false } = {}) {
    const builder = getRequirementBuilder();
    const parking = getRequirementBuilderParking();

    if (window.activeNigoRow) {
      syncActiveNigoRequirement();
    }

    if (builder && parking) {
      parking.appendChild(builder);
    }

    window.activeNigoRow = null;

    const activeFormDisplay = $("activeNigoFormDisplay");

    if (activeFormDisplay) {
      activeFormDisplay.textContent = "Select a requirement for this form.";
    }

    if (clearDraft) {
      clearGlobalRequirementDraft();
    }
  }

  function mountRequirementBuilder(row) {
    if (!row) {
      return;
    }

    const builder = getRequirementBuilder();

    const host = row.querySelector(".nigo-requirement-host");

    if (!builder || !host) {
      console.warn("The NIGO requirement builder or host was not found.");

      return;
    }

    if (window.activeNigoRow && window.activeNigoRow !== row) {
      syncActiveNigoRequirement();
    }

    window.activeNigoRow = row;
    host.appendChild(builder);

    const formId = row.dataset.formId || "";

    const formDescription = row.dataset.formDescription || formId;

    const activeFormDisplay = $("activeNigoFormDisplay");

    if (activeFormDisplay) {
      activeFormDisplay.textContent = `${formId} — ${formDescription}`;
    }

    restoreRequirementDraft(formId);

    window.setTimeout(() => {
      $("globalRequirementTemplate")?.focus();
    }, 0);
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * AMENDMENT FORM DROPDOWN
   * =========================================================
   */

  function populateAmendmentFormDropdown(applicableForms) {
    const dropdown = $("globalAmendmentForm");

    if (!dropdown) {
      return;
    }

    dropdown.innerHTML = '<option value="">Select Form</option>';

    applicableForms.forEach((form) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");

      option.value = form.form;

      option.textContent = `${form.form} - ${form.description}`;

      dropdown.appendChild(option);
    });

    console.log("Amendment form options:", dropdown.options.length);
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * STATE FORM RENDERING
   * =========================================================
   */

  function renderStateGuidance(stateData) {
    const requiredForms = $("requiredForms");
    const summary = $("stateRequirementSummary");
    const completionBanner = $("reviewCompletionBanner");

    if (!requiredForms) {
      console.warn(
        "Unable to render state forms because #requiredForms was not found.",
      );

      return;
    }

    /*
     * The old active row is about to be removed.
     */
    parkRequirementBuilder({
      clearDraft: true,
    });

    if (completionBanner) {
      completionBanner.hidden = true;
    }

    renderNotices(stateData);
    renderNotes(stateData);

    const stateForms = Array.isArray(stateData.forms) ? stateData.forms : [];

    const applicableForms = stateForms.filter((form) => {
      if (form.required === true) {
        return true;
      }

      return evaluateConditions(form.conditions || []);
    });

    populateAmendmentFormDropdown(applicableForms);

    if (summary) {
      summary.textContent = `${stateData.displayName} Requirements`;
    }

    requiredForms.innerHTML = applicableForms
      .map((form) => {
        const formId = escapeHTML(form.form);
        const description = escapeHTML(form.description);

        return `
          <div
            class="required-form-row"
            data-form-id="${formId}"
            data-form-description="${description}"
          >
            <div class="state-form-main">

              <div class="state-form-content">
                <strong class="state-form-id">
                  ${formId}
                </strong>

                <span class="form-description">
                  ${description}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div class="form-status-actions">

                <span
                  class="form-review-result"
                  data-result="${formId}"
                  aria-live="polite"
                ></span>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  class="form-status-button igo-button"
                  data-form="${formId}"
                  aria-pressed="false"
                >
                  IGO
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  class="form-status-button nigo-button"
                  data-form="${formId}"
                  aria-pressed="false"
                >
                  NIGO
                </button>

              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              class="nigo-template-picker"
              hidden
            >
              <div
                class="nigo-requirement-host"
              ></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      })
      .join("");

    const formCount = $("applicableFormCount");

    if (formCount) {
      formCount.textContent = String(applicableForms.length);
    }

    updateStateDashboard();
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * IGO / NIGO BUTTON HANDLER
   * =========================================================
   */

  function handleRequiredFormsClick(event) {
    const igoButtonClicked = event.target.closest(".igo-button");

    const nigoButtonClicked = event.target.closest(".nigo-button");

    if (!igoButtonClicked && !nigoButtonClicked) {
      return;
    }

    const clickedButton = igoButtonClicked || nigoButtonClicked;

    const row = clickedButton.closest(".required-form-row");

    if (!row) {
      return;
    }

    const formId = row.dataset.formId || "";

    const formDescription = row.dataset.formDescription || formId;

    const igoButton = row.querySelector(".igo-button");

    const nigoButton = row.querySelector(".nigo-button");

    const resultText = row.querySelector(".form-review-result");

    const nigoPicker = row.querySelector(".nigo-template-picker");

    /*
     * IGO
     */
    if (igoButtonClicked) {
      igoButton?.classList.add("selected");

      igoButton?.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");

      nigoButton?.classList.remove("selected");

      nigoButton?.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");

      if (window.activeNigoRow === row) {
        parkRequirementBuilder({
          clearDraft: true,
        });
      }

      if (nigoPicker) {
        nigoPicker.hidden = true;
      }

      row.dataset.formStatus = "igo";

      window.formReviewStatus[formId] = {
        status: "IGO",
        issueLabel: "",
        templateId: "",
        formId,
        formDescription,
        requirementGenerated: false,
        requirementText: "",
        fieldValues: {},
      };

      if (resultText) {
        resultText.textContent = "Reviewed";
        resultText.className = "form-review-result result-igo";
        resultText.title = "";
      }

      updateStateDashboard();
      checkReviewCompletion();

      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("stateFormsUpdated"));

      return;
    }

    /*
     * NIGO
     */
    if (nigoButtonClicked) {
      if (window.activeNigoRow && window.activeNigoRow !== row) {
        syncActiveNigoRequirement();
      }

      nigoButton?.classList.add("selected");

      nigoButton?.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "true");

      igoButton?.classList.remove("selected");

      igoButton?.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");

      row.dataset.formStatus = "nigo-pending";

      if (!window.formReviewStatus[formId]) {
        window.formReviewStatus[formId] = {
          status: "NIGO_PENDING",
          issueLabel: "",
          templateId: "",
          formId,
          formDescription,
          requirementGenerated: false,
          requirementText: "",
          fieldValues: {},
        };
      }

      if (nigoPicker) {
        nigoPicker.hidden = false;
      }

      if (resultText) {
        resultText.textContent = window.formReviewStatus[formId]?.templateId
          ? `NIGO: ${window.formReviewStatus[formId].issueLabel}`
          : "Select Requirement";

        resultText.className = window.formReviewStatus[formId]?.templateId
          ? "form-review-result result-nigo"
          : "form-review-result result-nigo-pending";
      }

      mountRequirementBuilder(row);

      updateStateDashboard();

      document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("stateFormsUpdated"));
    }
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * DASHBOARD
   * =========================================================
   */

  function checkReviewCompletion() {
    const rows = document.querySelectorAll(".required-form-row");

    const reviewedRows = document.querySelectorAll(
      '.required-form-row[data-form-status="igo"],' +
        '.required-form-row[data-form-status="nigo"]',
    );

    const completionBanner = $("reviewCompletionBanner");

    const complete = rows.length > 0 && reviewedRows.length === rows.length;

    if (completionBanner) {
      completionBanner.hidden = !complete;
    }

    if (complete) {
      console.log("State review complete.");
    }
  }

  function updateStateDashboard() {
    const total = document.querySelectorAll(".required-form-row").length;

    const statuses = Object.values(window.formReviewStatus);

    const reviewed = statuses.filter((item) => {
      return item?.status === "IGO" || item?.status === "NIGO";
    }).length;

    const issues = statuses.filter((item) => {
      return item?.status === "NIGO";
    }).length;

    const remaining = Math.max(total - reviewed, 0);

    if ($("reviewedCountCard")) {
      $("reviewedCountCard").textContent = String(reviewed);
    }

    if ($("remainingCountCard")) {
      $("remainingCountCard").textContent = String(remaining);
    }

    if ($("dashboardIssueCount")) {
      $("dashboardIssueCount").textContent = String(issues);
    }

    if ($("dashboardState")) {
      $("dashboardState").textContent = $("contractState")?.value || "--";
    }

    updateNigoDashboard();
  }

  function updateNigoDashboard() {
    const issueContainer = $("openNigoList");
    const countElement = $("openNigoCount");

    if (!issueContainer || !countElement) {
      return;
    }

    const nigos = Object.values(window.formReviewStatus).filter((item) => {
      return item?.status === "NIGO";
    });

    countElement.textContent = String(nigos.length);

    if (!nigos.length) {
      issueContainer.innerHTML = `
        <div class="nigo-empty">
          No documented NIGOs
        </div>
      `;

      return;
    }

    issueContainer.innerHTML = nigos
      .map((item) => {
        return `
          <div class="nigo-issue-item">
            <div class="nigo-issue-form">
              ${escapeHTML(item.formId)}
            </div>

            <div class="nigo-issue-reason">
              ${escapeHTML(item.issueLabel)}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      })
      .join("");
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * GLOBAL REQUIREMENT GENERATOR EVENTS
   * =========================================================
   */

  function bindRequirementGeneratorEvents() {
    document.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (event.target.id === "globalRequirementTemplate") {
        refreshActiveNigoRequirement();
        return;
      }

      if (event.target.closest("#globalRequirementFields")) {
        refreshActiveNigoRequirement();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
      if (event.target.closest("#globalRequirementFields")) {
        refreshActiveNigoRequirement();
      }
    });

    /*
     * Sync the active form before amendment-engine.js
     * handles the Add Requirement button.
     */
    document.addEventListener(
      "click",
      (event) => {
        if (event.target.closest("#addGlobalRequirement")) {
          syncActiveNigoRequirement();
        }
      },
      true,
    );
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * STATE LOADING
   * =========================================================
   */

  async function loadSelectedState(stateCode) {
    const requiredForms = $("requiredForms");
    const completionBanner = $("reviewCompletionBanner");

    if (!stateCode) {
      window.formReviewStatus = {};

      parkRequirementBuilder({
        clearDraft: true,
      });

      if (requiredForms) {
        requiredForms.innerHTML = "";
      }

      if ($("stateImportantNotices")) {
        $("stateImportantNotices").innerHTML = "";
        $("stateImportantNotices").hidden = true;
      }

      if ($("stateNotes")) {
        $("stateNotes").innerHTML = "";
        $("stateNotes").hidden = true;
      }

      if ($("applicableFormCount")) {
        $("applicableFormCount").textContent = "0";
      }

      if (completionBanner) {
        completionBanner.hidden = true;
      }

      return;
    }

    window.formReviewStatus = {};

    try {
      const url = `./data/States/${stateCode}.json`;

      console.log("Loading state:", url);

      const response = await fetch(url, {
        cache: "no-store",
      });

      console.log("Status:", response.status);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`${stateCode}.json not found`);
      }

      const stateData = await response.json();

      window.currentStateData = stateData;

      console.log("STATE DATA", stateData);
      console.log("FORMS ARRAY", stateData.forms);
      console.log("FORMS LENGTH", stateData.forms?.length);

      renderStateGuidance(stateData);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("State load failed:", error);

      if (requiredForms) {
        requiredForms.innerHTML = `
          <div class="state-load-error">
            Unable to load the selected state's forms.
          </div>
        `;
      }
    }
  }

  /*
   * =========================================================
   * INITIALIZATION
   * =========================================================
   */

  function initializeStateLoader() {
    const stateDropdown = $("contractState");
    const requiredForms = $("requiredForms");

    if (!stateDropdown) {
      console.error("Missing #contractState.");

      return;
    }

    if (!requiredForms) {
      console.error("Missing #requiredForms.");

      return;
    }

    stateDropdown.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      loadSelectedState(event.target.value);
    });

    requiredForms.addEventListener("click", handleRequiredFormsClick);

    bindRequirementGeneratorEvents();

    if (stateDropdown.value) {
      loadSelectedState(stateDropdown.value);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeStateLoader, {
      once: true,
    });
  } else {
    initializeStateLoader();
  }
})();

```

```javascript
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  window.globalSavedRequirements = Array.isArray(window.globalSavedRequirements)
    ? window.globalSavedRequirements
    : [];

  window.globalSavedAmendments = Array.isArray(window.globalSavedAmendments)
    ? window.globalSavedAmendments
    : [];

  function getRequirementTexts() {
    return window.globalSavedRequirements
      .map((requirement) => {
        if (typeof requirement === "string") {
          return requirement.trim();
        }

        return String(requirement?.text || "").trim();
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  function getAmendmentTexts() {
    return window.globalSavedAmendments
      .map((amendment) => {
        if (typeof amendment === "string") {
          return amendment.trim();
        }

        return String(amendment?.text || "").trim();
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  }

  function getFormCount() {
    return document.querySelectorAll("#requiredForms .required-form-row")
      .length;
  }

  function updateStateDashboard() {
    const stateDropdown = $("contractState");
    const dashboardState = $("dashboardState");

    if (dashboardState) {
      dashboardState.textContent = stateDropdown?.value || "--";
    }
  }

  function updateFormDashboard() {
    const formCount = getFormCount();
    const dashboardCount = $("dashboardFormCount");

    if (dashboardCount) {
      dashboardCount.textContent = String(formCount);
    }
  }

  function renderRequirements() {
    const requirements = getRequirementTexts();
    const count = requirements.length;

    const output = $("compiledRequirements");
    const hiddenCount = $("compiledRequirementCount");
    const badge = $("compiledRequirementBadge");
    const dashboardCount = $("dashboardRequirementCount");
    const copyButton = $("copyAllRequirements");
    const clearButton = $("clearAllRequirements");

    if (output) {
      output.value = requirements
        .map((requirement, index) => {
          return `${index + 1}. ${requirement}`;
        })
        .join("\n\n");
    }

    if (hiddenCount) {
      hiddenCount.textContent = String(count);
    }

    if (badge) {
      badge.textContent =
        count === 1 ? "1 requirement" : `${count} requirements`;
    }

    if (dashboardCount) {
      dashboardCount.textContent = String(count);
    }

    if (copyButton) {
      copyButton.disabled = count === 0;
    }

    if (clearButton) {
      clearButton.disabled = count === 0;
    }
  }

  function renderAmendments() {
    const amendments = getAmendmentTexts();
    const count = amendments.length;

    const output = $("compiledAmendments");
    const hiddenCount = $("compiledAmendmentCount");
    const badge = $("compiledAmendmentBadge");
    const dashboardCount = $("dashboardAmendmentCount");
    const copyButton = $("copyAllAmendments");
    const clearButton = $("clearAllAmendments");

    if (output) {
      output.value = amendments
        .map((amendment, index) => {
          return `${index + 1}. ${amendment}`;
        })
        .join("\n\n");
    }

    if (hiddenCount) {
      hiddenCount.textContent = String(count);
    }

    if (badge) {
      badge.textContent = count === 1 ? "1 amendment" : `${count} amendments`;
    }

    if (dashboardCount) {
      dashboardCount.textContent = String(count);
    }

    if (copyButton) {
      copyButton.disabled = count === 0;
    }

    if (clearButton) {
      clearButton.disabled = count === 0;
    }
  }

  function updateOutputSummary() {
    const requirementCount = getRequirementTexts().length;

    const amendmentCount = getAmendmentTexts().length;

    const totalCount = requirementCount + amendmentCount;

    const total = $("compiledTotalCount");
    const status = $("reviewOutputStatus");

    if (total) {
      total.textContent = totalCount === 1 ? "1 item" : `${totalCount} items`;
    }

    if (status) {
      status.textContent = totalCount > 0 ? "Output ready" : "No outputs";
    }
  }

  function renderEverything() {
    updateStateDashboard();
    updateFormDashboard();
    renderRequirements();
    renderAmendments();
    updateOutputSummary();
  }

  function showStatus(elementId, message, isError = false) {
    const status = $(elementId);

    if (!status) {
      return;
    }

    status.textContent = message;
    status.classList.toggle("is-error", isError);

    window.clearTimeout(status.clearTimer);

    status.clearTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      status.textContent = "";
      status.classList.remove("is-error");
    }, 3000);
  }

  async function copyText(text, successMessage) {
    const value = String(text || "").trim();

    if (!value) {
      showStatus(
        "reviewOutputCopyStatus",
        "There is no wording to copy.",
        true,
      );

      return;
    }

    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);

      showStatus("reviewOutputCopyStatus", successMessage);
    } catch (error) {
      const helper = document.createElement("textarea");

      helper.value = value;
      helper.setAttribute("readonly", "");
      helper.style.position = "fixed";
      helper.style.opacity = "0";

      document.body.appendChild(helper);
      helper.select();

      const copied = document.execCommand("copy");

      helper.remove();

      showStatus(
        "reviewOutputCopyStatus",
        copied
          ? successMessage
          : "Copy was unavailable. Copy the wording manually.",
        !copied,
      );
    }
  }

  function addAmendment() {
    const generatedOutput = $("globalGeneratedAmendment");

    const amendmentText = generatedOutput?.value.trim() || "";

    if (!amendmentText) {
      showStatus(
        "amendmentSaveStatus",
        "Select an amendment template and complete the wording first.",
        true,
      );

      return;
    }

    const duplicateExists = getAmendmentTexts().includes(amendmentText);

    if (duplicateExists) {
      showStatus(
        "amendmentSaveStatus",
        "This amendment has already been added.",
        true,
      );

      return;
    }

    window.globalSavedAmendments.push(amendmentText);

    renderEverything();

    document.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("verbiageAmendmentsUpdated", {
        detail: {
          amendments: window.globalSavedAmendments,
        },
      }),
    );

    showStatus("amendmentSaveStatus", "Amendment added.");
  }

  function clearRequirements() {
    window.globalSavedRequirements.length = 0;

    document.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("requirementsUpdated", {
        detail: {
          requirements: [],
        },
      }),
    );

    renderEverything();

    showStatus("reviewOutputCopyStatus", "Requirements cleared.");
  }

  function clearAmendments() {
    window.globalSavedAmendments.length = 0;

    document.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("verbiageAmendmentsUpdated", {
        detail: {
          amendments: [],
        },
      }),
    );

    renderEverything();

    showStatus("reviewOutputCopyStatus", "Amendments cleared.");
  }

  function handleButtonClick(event) {
    const button = event.target.closest("button");

    if (!button) {
      return;
    }

    switch (button.id) {
      case "addGlobalAmendment":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        addAmendment();
        break;

      case "copyGlobalAmendment":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        copyText($("globalGeneratedAmendment")?.value, "Amendment copied.");
        break;

      case "copyAllRequirements":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        copyText($("compiledRequirements")?.value, "Requirements copied.");
        break;

      case "clearAllRequirements":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        clearRequirements();
        break;

      case "copyAllAmendments":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();

        copyText($("compiledAmendments")?.value, "Amendments copied.");
        break;

      case "clearAllAmendments":
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        clearAmendments();
        break;

      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  function initializeVerbiageOutput() {
    document.addEventListener("click", handleButtonClick, true);

    $("contractState")?.addEventListener("change", () => {
      window.setTimeout(renderEverything, 0);
    });

    document.addEventListener("requirementsUpdated", () => {
      window.setTimeout(renderEverything, 0);
    });

    document.addEventListener("compiledRequirementsUpdated", () => {
      window.setTimeout(renderEverything, 0);
    });

    document.addEventListener("stateFormsUpdated", () => {
      window.setTimeout(renderEverything, 0);
    });

    const requiredForms = $("requiredForms");

    if (requiredForms) {
      const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
        renderEverything();
      });

      observer.observe(requiredForms, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
      });
    }

    renderEverything();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeVerbiageOutput, {
      once: true,
    });
  } else {
    initializeVerbiageOutput();
  }
})();

        stateChip.textContent =
```

```javascript
      (() => {
        "use strict";

        const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

        const contractState = $("contractState");
        const selectedState = $("selectedState");
        const selectedStateDisplay = $("selectedStateDisplay");
        const requiredForms = $("requiredForms");
        const amendmentParking = $("amendmentWorkspaceParking");
        const amendmentWorkspace = $("inlineAmendmentWorkspace");
        const amendmentForm = $("globalAmendmentForm");
        const amendmentTemplate = $("globalAmendmentTemplate");
        const amendmentFields = $("globalAmendmentFields");
        const generatedAmendment = $("globalGeneratedAmendment");
        const compiledRequirements = $("compiledRequirements");
        const compiledAmendments = $("compiledAmendments");
        const emailOutput = $("emailOutput");

        function setStatus(id, message, isError = false) {
          const element = $(id);
          if (!element) return;

          element.textContent = message;
          element.classList.toggle("is-error", isError);

          window.clearTimeout(element._clearTimer);
          element._clearTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
            element.textContent = "";
            element.classList.remove("is-error");
          }, 3500);
        }

        async function copyText(text, statusId, successMessage) {
          const value = (text || "").trim();

          if (!value) {
            setStatus(statusId, "There is no wording to copy yet.", true);
            return;
          }

          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
            setStatus(statusId, successMessage);
          } catch (error) {
            const helper = document.createElement("textarea");
            helper.value = value;
            helper.setAttribute("readonly", "");
            helper.style.position = "fixed";
            helper.style.opacity = "0";
            document.body.appendChild(helper);
            helper.select();

            const copied = document.execCommand("copy");
            helper.remove();

            setStatus(
              statusId,
              copied
                ? successMessage
                : "Copy was unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.",
              !copied
            );
          }
        }

        function updateStateContext() {
          const selectedOption =
            contractState.options[contractState.selectedIndex];
          const stateName = contractState.value
            ? selectedOption.textContent
            : "";

          selectedState.value = contractState.value;
          selectedStateDisplay.textContent = stateName || "No state selected";
          selectedStateDisplay.dataset.empty = String(!stateName);

          returnAmendmentWorkspace();

          selectedState.dispatchEvent(
            new Event("change", { bubbles: true })
          );
        }

        function returnAmendmentWorkspace() {
          amendmentWorkspace.open = false;
          amendmentParking.appendChild(amendmentWorkspace);
          amendmentParking.classList.add("vc-engine-parking");
          $("activeNigoFormName").value = "";
        }

        function findFormCard(startElement) {
          let current = startElement;

          while (current && current !== requiredForms) {
            const text = (current.textContent || "").toLowerCase();
            const hasStatusControl =
              current.querySelector &&
              Array.from(current.querySelectorAll("button")).some((button) =>
                /\bigo\b|\bnigo\b/i.test(button.textContent || "")
              );

            if (hasStatusControl || text.includes("why is this form nigo")) {
              return current;
            }

            current = current.parentElement;
          }

          return null;
        }

        function readFormIdentity(card) {
          const dataValue =
            card.dataset.formId ||
            card.dataset.formName ||
            card.dataset.form ||
            "";

          if (dataValue) return dataValue.trim();

          const heading = card.querySelector(
            "h2, h3, h4, strong, .form-id, .form-name, [data-form-id]"
          );

          return heading ? heading.textContent.trim() : "Selected state form";
        }

        function attachAmendmentWorkspace(card) {
          if (!card) return;

          const formName = readFormIdentity(card);
          $("activeNigoFormName").value = formName;

          amendmentParking.classList.remove("vc-engine-parking");
          card.appendChild(amendmentWorkspace);

          amendmentForm.innerHTML = "";
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = formName;
          option.textContent = formName;
          option.selected = true;
          amendmentForm.appendChild(option);
          amendmentForm.value = formName;
          amendmentForm.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));

          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (amendmentTemplate.options.length > 1) {
              amendmentTemplate.disabled = false;
            }
          }, 0);
        }

        requiredForms.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          const button = event.target.closest("button");
          if (!button) return;

          const label = (button.textContent || "").trim();
          const card = findFormCard(button);

          if (/^nigo$/i.test(label) || /mark.*nigo/i.test(label)) {
            window.setTimeout(() => attachAmendmentWorkspace(card), 0);
          }

          if (/^igo$/i.test(label) || /mark.*igo/i.test(label)) {
            if (card && card.contains(amendmentWorkspace)) {
              returnAmendmentWorkspace();
            }
          }

          if (/add requirement/i.test(label)) {
            window.setTimeout(refreshSelectedWording, 0);
          }
        });

        requiredForms.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
          const card = findFormCard(event.target);
          const text = (card?.textContent || "").toLowerCase();

          if (text.includes("nigo")) {
            attachAmendmentWorkspace(card);
          }
        });

        new MutationObserver(() => {
          const cards = Array.from(requiredForms.children);
          $("applicableFormCount").textContent = cards.length;
        }).observe(requiredForms, {
          childList: true,
          subtree: true
        });

        function countEntries(value) {
          const text = (value || "").trim();
          if (!text) return 0;

          const listItems = text.match(/^\s*(?:\d+[.)]|[-•])\s+/gm);
          if (listItems?.length) return listItems.length;

          return text
            .split(/\n\s*\n/)
            .map((entry) => entry.trim())
            .filter(Boolean).length;
        }

        function refreshSelectedWording() {
          const requirementCount = countEntries(compiledRequirements.value);
          const amendmentCount = countEntries(compiledAmendments.value);
          const totalCount = requirementCount + amendmentCount;

          $("compiledRequirementBadge").textContent = requirementCount;
          $("compiledRequirementCount").textContent = requirementCount;
          $("compiledAmendmentBadge").textContent = amendmentCount;
          $("compiledAmendmentCount").textContent = amendmentCount;
          $("compiledTotalCount").textContent = `${totalCount} ${
            totalCount === 1 ? "item" : "items"
          }`;
          $("reviewOutputStatus").textContent = totalCount
            ? "Outputs ready"
            : "No outputs";
          $("copyAllRequirements").disabled = requirementCount === 0;
          $("copyAllAmendments").disabled = amendmentCount === 0;
        }

        function clearAmendmentBuilder() {
          amendmentTemplate.value = "";
          amendmentFields.innerHTML = "";
          generatedAmendment.value = "";
          amendmentTemplate.dispatchEvent(
            new Event("change", { bubbles: true })
          );
          setStatus("amendmentActionStatus", "Amendment cleared.");
        }

        function buildFallbackEmail() {
          const requirements = compiledRequirements.value.trim();
          const amendments = compiledAmendments.value.trim();
          const recipient = $("emailGreetingName").value.trim();
          const sender = $("emailSignatureName").value.trim();

          if (!requirements && !amendments) {
            setStatus(
              "emailActionStatus",
              "Add at least one requirement or amendment before building the email.",
              true
            );
            return;
          }

          const lines = [
            "Subject: Additional Requirements for Case Review",
            "",
            recipient ? `Hello ${recipient},` : "Hello,",
            "",
            "During our review, we identified the following outstanding items:"
          ];

          if (amendments) {
            lines.push("", "Amendments Required", amendments);
          }

          if (requirements) {
            lines.push("", "Requirements Needed", requirements);
          }

          lines.push(
            "",
            "Please submit the requested items so we may continue processing the case.",
            "",
            "Thank you,"
          );

          if (sender) lines.push(sender);

          emailOutput.innerText = lines.join("\n");
          setStatus("emailActionStatus", "Email built. You can edit it before copying.");
        }

        contractState.addEventListener("change", updateStateContext);

        $("copyAmendment").addEventListener("click", () => {
          copyText(
            generatedAmendment.value,
            "amendmentActionStatus",
            "Amendment copied."
          );
        });

        $("clearAmendment").addEventListener("click", clearAmendmentBuilder);

        $("addAmendmentToPackage").addEventListener("click", () => {
          window.setTimeout(refreshSelectedWording, 0);
        });

        $("copyAllRequirements").addEventListener("click", () => {
          copyText(
            compiledRequirements.value,
            "reviewOutputCopyStatus",
            "Requirements copied."
          );
        });

        $("copyAllAmendments").addEventListener("click", () => {
          copyText(
            compiledAmendments.value,
            "reviewOutputCopyStatus",
            "Amendments copied."
          );
        });

        $("clearAllRequirements").addEventListener("click", () => {
          compiledRequirements.value = "";
          compiledRequirements.dispatchEvent(
            new Event("input", { bubbles: true })
          );
          refreshSelectedWording();
          setStatus("reviewOutputCopyStatus", "Requirements cleared.");
        });

        $("clearAllAmendments").addEventListener("click", () => {
          compiledAmendments.value = "";
          compiledAmendments.dispatchEvent(
            new Event("input", { bubbles: true })
          );
          refreshSelectedWording();
          setStatus("reviewOutputCopyStatus", "Amendments cleared.");
        });

        $("generateEmail").addEventListener("click", () => {
          window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (!emailOutput.innerText.trim()) {
              buildFallbackEmail();
            }
          }, 0);
        });

        $("copyEmail").addEventListener("click", () => {
          copyText(emailOutput.innerText, "emailActionStatus", "Email copied.");
        });

        $("clearEmail").addEventListener("click", () => {
          emailOutput.innerHTML = "";
          setStatus("emailActionStatus", "Email cleared.");
        });

        [compiledRequirements, compiledAmendments].forEach((element) => {
          element.addEventListener("input", refreshSelectedWording);
          element.addEventListener("change", refreshSelectedWording);
        });

        updateStateContext();
        refreshSelectedWording();
      })();
```

```css
.procedure-list li::before {
    position: absolute;
    top: 17px;
    left: 18px;
    display: grid;
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    place-items: center;
    border-radius: 50%;
    color: #ffffff;
    background: var(--forms-blue);
    content: counter(procedure);
    font-weight: 900;
}

.procedure-list strong {
    color: var(--forms-navy);
}

.procedure-list p {
    margin: 6px 0 0;
    color: var(--forms-muted);
    line-height: 1.55;
}


.forms-toolbar {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 0.8fr 1.4fr 0.9fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.forms-field {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
}

.forms-field label {
    color: var(--forms-navy);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
}

.forms-field input,
.forms-field select {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 50px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--forms-border);
    border-radius: 14px;
    color: var(--forms-ink);
    background: #ffffff;
    font: inherit;
}

.forms-field input:focus,
.forms-field select:focus {
    border-color: var(--forms-charge-blue);
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(2, 101, 255, 0.11);
}

.state-notice-panel {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding: 18px;
    border: 1px solid #ffd391;
    border-left: 5px solid #d98200;
    border-radius: 16px;
    color: #694000;
    background: #fff9ed;
}

.state-notice-panel h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    color: #694000;
    font-size: 16px;
}

.state-notice-panel p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.55;
}


.forms-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
}

.form-download-card {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--forms-border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: #ffffff;
    transition:
        transform 200ms ease,
        border-color 200ms ease,
        box-shadow 200ms ease;
}

.form-download-card::before {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0 auto 0 0;
    width: 4px;
    background:
        linear-gradient(
            180deg,
            var(--forms-cyan),
            var(--forms-charge-blue)
        );
    content: "";
}

.form-download-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    border-color: #b6d5f7;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 67, 145, 0.09);
}

.form-name-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.form-number {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--forms-navy);
    font-size: 17px;
}

.form-category {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 25px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: #0057b8;
    background: #eef6ff;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.form-title {
    margin: 7px 0 0;
    color: var(--forms-muted);
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.form-note {
    margin: 10px 0 0;
    color: #8a5100;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.form-download-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 126px;
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-radius: 13px;
    color: #ffffff;
    background:
        linear-gradient(
            135deg,
            var(--forms-blue),
            var(--forms-charge-blue)
        );
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition:
        transform 200ms ease,
        box-shadow 200ms ease;
}

.form-download-button:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(2, 101, 255, 0.23);
}

.form-unavailable {
    min-width: 126px;
    color: var(--forms-muted);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-align: center;
}




.forms-empty-state {
    padding: 64px 24px;
    border: 1px dashed #bdd0e4;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #f8fbff;
    text-align: center;
}

.empty-state-icon {
    display: grid;
    width: 62px;
    height: 62px;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    place-items: center;
    border-radius: 20px;
    color: #0057b8;
    background: #eaf4ff;
    font-size: 30px;
}

.forms-empty-state h3 {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--forms-navy);
}

.forms-empty-state p {
    margin: 9px 0 0;
    color: var(--forms-muted);
}




.forms-footer {
    padding: 24px 20px;
    color: #d7e6f8;
    background: var(--forms-navy);
    text-align: center;
}

.forms-footer p {
    margin: 0;
}




@media (max-width: 900px) {

    .information-grid,
    .forms-toolbar {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

}

@media (max-width: 680px) {

    .forms-hero {
        padding: 110px 20px 58px;
    }

    .forms-shell {
        width: min(100% - 24px, 1180px);
    }

    .forms-card {
        padding: 20px;
        border-radius: 18px;
    }

    .section-heading {
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .form-download-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .form-download-button,
    .form-unavailable {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .reference-details summary {

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: space-between;

    gap: 24px;

    padding: 24px 28px;

    cursor: pointer;

    width: 100%;
}

    .details-content {
        padding: 0 20px 20px;
    }

}

.form-download-card__action a {

    display: inline-flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: center;

    gap: 6px;

    padding: 8px 14px;

    border-radius: 999px;

    background: #eef6ff;

    color: #0057b8;

    text-decoration: none;

    font-size: 13px;

    font-weight: 700;

    border: 1px solid #cfe0f7;

    transition: .2s ease;
}

.form-download-card__action a:hover {

    background: #dbeafe;

    border-color: #a8c9ff;

    color: #0057b8;

    text-decoration: none;
}


.form-download-button span {

    color: inherit;
}

```

```css
  font-weight: 700;

  cursor: pointer;

  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}
.question-option:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);

  border-color: #0265ff;

  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(2, 101, 255, 0.12);
}

#contractState {
  width: 360px;

  height: 60px;

  padding: 0 18px;

  border-radius: 16px;

  border: 2px solid #d7e6f5;

  background: white;

  font-size: 16px;

  font-weight: 600;
}
#contractState:focus {
  outline: none;

  border-color: #0265ff;

  box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(2, 101, 255, 0.12);
}
.wizard-progress-top {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;

  margin-bottom: 9px;
}

#wizardProgressLabel {
  color: #102a43;

}

#wizardProgressPercent {

}

#wizardProgress {

  border-radius: 999px;
}

#wizardProgressFill {

}

.wizard-answer-empty {

.wizard-answer-summary {

}
.wizard-answer-inline {

  line-height: 1.5;
}
.question-container {
  width: min(900px, 100%);

  margin: 0 auto;

  padding: 40px;

  text-align: center;
}

@keyframes answerChipReveal {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(5px) scale(0.96);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {

    top: 8px;
    padding: 13px 14px;

    border-radius: 14px;
  }

    gap: 5px;
  }

    padding: 0 8px;

    font-size: 9px;
  }

#wizardProgressWrapper.fade-out {
  opacity: 0;

  transform: translateY(-24px);

  transition:
    opacity 0.4s ease,

}

.completion-badge {

}
.completion-container p {

.profile-summary-item {

.question-option.selected {

#qualificationSummary.is-launching {

/* ======================================================
   FULL IR - ILLUSTRATION VALIDATION
====================================================== */

.illustration-validation-section {
  padding: 24px;
  margin-top: 24px;
  border: 1px solid #d6e1ec;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98),
    rgba(244, 249, 255, 0.98)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 46, 107, 0.08);
}

.illustration-validation-section .section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.illustration-validation-section .section-header h2 {
  margin: 4px 0;
  color: #002e6b;
  font-size: 1.55rem;
}

.illustration-validation-section .section-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: #5a6a7c;
}

.section-eyebrow {
  color: #0076a8;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.validation-notice {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #b9dff2;
  border-left: 5px solid #4dc7eb;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #f0faff;
  color: #123b5d;
}

.validation-control-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #f5f8fc;
}

.validation-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  min-width: 220px;
}

.validation-field label {
  color: #26384b;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.validation-field select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #aebed0;
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.validation-upload-grid,
.validation-extracted-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
}

.validation-upload-card,
.validation-results-card {
  padding: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #d7e1ed;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.validation-upload-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.validation-upload-heading h3,
.validation-results-card h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #002e6b;
}

.validation-upload-heading p,
.validation-results-heading p {
  margin: 3px 0 0;
  color: #637386;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
}

.validation-step {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  flex: 0 0 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #002e6b;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.validation-drop-zone {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  min-height: 170px;
  padding: 24px;
  border: 2px dashed #8da8c3;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #f8fbff;
  color: #002e6b;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 160ms ease,
    background 160ms ease,
    transform 160ms ease;
}

.validation-drop-zone:hover,
.validation-drop-zone.is-dragging {
  border-color: #0265ff;
  background: #edf5ff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.validation-drop-zone input {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  opacity: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.validation-drop-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 15px;
  background: #e5f1ff;
  color: #002e6b;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.validation-file-meta {
  margin-top: 10px;
  color: #637386;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.validation-action-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin: 18px 0;
}

.validation-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.validation-status-pending,
.validation-status-neutral {
  background: #eef2f6;
  color: #596879;
}

.validation-status-good {
  background: #e8f7ef;
  color: #147a4f;
}

.validation-status-warning {
  background: #fff4d4;
  color: #8b6000;
}

.validation-status-error {
  background: #feeceb;
  color: #b42318;
}

.validation-error {
  padding: 12px 14px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  border: 1px solid #efb6b2;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #feeceb;
  color: #a62117;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.validation-summary-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.validation-summary-card {
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #d7e1ed;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.validation-summary-card span {
  display: block;
  color: #637386;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.validation-summary-card strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: #002e6b;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
}

.validation-fields-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.validation-field-card {
  padding: 11px;
  border: 1px solid #d7e1ed;
  border-left: 5px solid #4dc7eb;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #ffffff;
}

.validation-field-card.is-high {
  border-left-color: #168454;
}

.validation-field-card.is-medium {
  border-left-color: #0265ff;
}

.validation-field-card.is-low {
  border-left-color: #eca940;
}

.validation-field-card.is-excluded {
  border-left-color: #8996a3;
  background: #f7f9fb;
}

.validation-field-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.validation-field-heading strong {
  color: #102a43;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.validation-confidence {
  color: #637386;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 900;
}

.validation-field-value {
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 8px 9px;
  border: 1px solid #b7c7d8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #071e35;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.validation-field-source {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 6px;
  color: #637386;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
}

.validation-results-card {
  margin-top: 18px;
}

.validation-results-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 18px;
}

.validation-table-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.validation-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}

.validation-table th,
.validation-table td {
  padding: 11px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #d7e1ed;
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
}

.validation-table th {
  background: #f3f7fb;
  color: #002e6b;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.validation-text-details {
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.validation-text-details summary {
  color: #002e6b;
  font-weight: 800;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.validation-text-details textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 220px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid #b7c7d8;
  border-radius: 9px;
  font-family: Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  resize: vertical;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .validation-upload-grid,
  .validation-extracted-grid,
  .validation-summary-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .validation-fields-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .illustration-validation-section .section-header,
  .validation-control-bar,
  .validation-results-heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

.iv-workflow-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  padding: 24px;

  border: 1px solid #d6e1ec;

  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.iv-workflow-top {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;

  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.iv-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;

  color: #0265ff;

  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.iv-workflow-top h3 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #002e6b;
}

.iv-status-pill {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;

  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.iv-status-pill.ready {
  background: #e7f7eb;
  color: #107c41;
}

.iv-file-status-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);

  gap: 18px;

  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.iv-file-status {
  background: #f8fbff;
  border: 1px solid #d9e6f5;

  border-radius: 14px;

  padding: 16px;
}

.iv-file-status span {
  display: block;

  color: #74869a;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.iv-file-status strong {
  color: #002e6b;
}

.iv-progress-track {
  height: 14px;

  background: #e6edf7;

  border-radius: 999px;

  overflow: hidden;

  margin-top: 10px;
}

.iv-progress-fill {
  width: 0%;

  height: 100%;

  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0265ff, #02a9ff);

  transition: width 0.4s ease;
}

.iv-step-list {
  margin-top: 24px;

  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.iv-step {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;

  gap: 10px;

  padding: 10px 14px;

  border-radius: 12px;

  background: #f8fbff;
}

.iv-step.complete {
  background: #ebf9ef;

  color: #107c41;
}

.iv-step.active {
  background: #e8f2ff;

  color: #0265ff;
}

.iv-step .step-icon {
  font-weight: 700;
}


.validation-drop-icon img {

    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    object-fit: contain;

}

.validation-drop-icon {

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;

}
```

```css
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.review-card input[type="checkbox"],
.review-card input[type="radio"] {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}
.review-card textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 1px solid #cbd5e0;
  resize: vertical;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.review-card textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #0b3a68;
}

.case-field {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}

.case-field label{

    display:block;

    margin-bottom:8px;

    font-size:14px;

    font-weight:700;

    color:#002e6b;

    text-transform:none;

    letter-spacing:0;

    line-height:1.3;

}

.case-field input,
.case-field select,
.case-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  height: 46px;
  padding: 0 14px;

  border: 1px solid #cfd9e8;
  border-radius: 14px;

  background: white;

  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: #0f172a;

  transition: 0.2s ease;
}

.case-field input:focus,
.case-field select:focus,
.case-field textarea:focus {
  outline: none;

  border-color: #0046ad;

  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0, 70, 173, 0.12);
}

.case-field input,
.case-field select{

    width:100%;

    height:52px;

    padding:0 16px;

    border:1px solid #d9e6f5;

    border-radius:12px;

    background:white;

    color:#001735;

    font-size:16px;

    font-weight:500;

}

#polarisReplacementCheckSection textarea {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100px;
}

.inline-requirement-builder textarea {
  width: 100%;

  min-height: 120px;

  margin-top: 12px;

  border-radius: 10px;

  border: 1px solid #cbd9ea;

  padding: 12px;
}

textarea {
  width: 100%;

  min-height: 180px;

  padding: 18px;

  border: 1px solid #d9e6f5;

  border-radius: 16px;

  font-family: inherit;

  font-size: 14px;

  resize: vertical;
}

.igo-button.selected {
  background: #12b76a;
  color: white;
}

.nigo-button.selected {
  background: #f97316;
  color: white;
}

.skip-workbench-button {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 24px;
  z-index: 200;

  padding: 10px 16px;

  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 46, 107, 0.2);
  border-radius: 999px;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  color: #002e6b;

  font-family: "Lato", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;

  cursor: pointer;

  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px);

  transition:
    background 200ms ease,
    border-color 200ms ease,
    transform 200ms ease;
}

.skip-workbench-button:hover {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-color: #0265ff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.form-status-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.form-status-button {
  border: none;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.igo-button {
  background: #ecfdf3;
  color: #027a48;
}

.nigo-button {
  background: #fff4ed;
  color: #c2410c;
}

.form-status-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.timer-mini-actions button {
  height: 28px;

  font-size: 11px;

  border-radius: 999px;
}

.section-header {
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: #0b3a68;
  color: white;
}

.section-header h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.section-header p {
  margin-top: 6px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.field-guidance {
  color: #475569;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin-top: 4px;
}

[hidden] {
  display: none !important;
}

#qualificationComplete:not([hidden]) {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;

  gap: 14px;
}
```

```css
body {
   margin: 0;
  font-family: "MM Sharp", "Century Gothic", "Futura", sans-serif;
   overflow-x: hidden;
}

h1,
h2,
h3 {
  font-family: "MM Sharp", "Century Gothic", "Futura", sans-serif;
}

body::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9998;

  background: rgba(0, 87, 184, 0.92);

  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;

  transition:
    opacity 500ms ease,
    visibility 0s linear 500ms;
}

body.workspace-launching::after {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;

  transition:
    opacity 500ms ease 300ms,
    visibility 0s linear 0s;
}
```

```css
    background: transparent;

    opacity: 0.5;
}

.ir-navigation img:hover {
    opacity: 1;
}

.ir-navigation span {

    font-size: 10px;

    letter-spacing: 0.5px;

    opacity: 0.5;
}

.ir-navigation span:hover {
    opacity: 1;
}

.ir-navigation a:hover {

    opacity: 1;

    transform: scale(1.08);
}
.required-form-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;

    padding: 18px 22px;
}

.state-form-main {
    width: 100%;

    display: flex;

    justify-content: space-between;

    align-items: center;

    gap: 24px;
}

.state-form-content {
    flex: 1;
}

.form-status-actions {

    display: flex;

    align-items: center;

    justify-content: flex-end;

    gap: 8px;

    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.nigo-generated-content {
    display: grid;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 22px;
}

.nigo-output-panel {
    padding: 22px;
    border: 1px solid #cfe0f5;
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(13, 45, 82, 0.06);
}

.nigo-output-panel[hidden] {
    display: none;
}

.nigo-output-panel h3 {
    margin: 0 0 16px;
    color: #0d2d52;
    font-size: 20px;
}

.nigo-output-panel label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 7px;
    color: #183b63;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.nigo-output-panel select,
.nigo-output-panel textarea {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 1px solid #c8d9ed;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #102a43;
    font: inherit;
}

.nigo-output-panel select {
    min-height: 44px;
    padding: 0 42px 0 14px;
}

.nigo-output-panel textarea {
    min-height: 140px;
    padding: 14px;
    resize: vertical;
}

.nigo-output-panel select:focus,
.nigo-output-panel textarea:focus {
    border-color: #1261d8;
    outline: 3px solid rgba(18, 97, 216, 0.12);
}
```
